_about: Sunday: product posts (5-slide carousel). Facts come ONLY from the live product page: run npm run products to see each product's live price and stock, and read the page itself for materials, care, delivery and returns. Never copy explicit wording from a product page (some descriptions are written for the website, not for social); describe how it feels and what it's like to own, never use on the body. Record the product in post.json as "product": { "slug": "...", "price": <naira shown on the slides> } so the publisher can hold the post if the price or stock changes before it goes out. A product that is out of stock is skipped until it's back. The same product appears at most once every 4 weeks. 'products' lists every product an item features; the first is the one recorded in post.json. PHOTOS: a product post may show the product's own photo with a slide { "type": "product", "slug": "...", "name": "...", "headline": "...", "price": <naira> }. Only the photo the catalogue names in 'photo' (a plain shot on white, chosen by hand: never one with printed claims like 'waterproof', never one in use). GitHub saves it every Saturday to state/site/product-<slug>.jpg. A product with photo: false is never shown, only described. Meta restricts posts promoting sex toys to adults 18+ and restricts 'depiction of sex toys with no clear context', so a photo always sits inside a guide, never alone. A price on a photo slide must be the post's own product.price, so the publisher's price check covers it.
